attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled: Press Release - Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Total income stood at Rs. 2,093.8 Crs, up approximately 36% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 77.7 Crs with margins at 3.7%. New vehicle volumes reached 19,052 units, a 46.4% increase year-on-year. The company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 2.2 Crs for the quarter. Promoter Mr. John K. Paul stepped away from the business effective 1st October 2026, with his shareholding to be transferred in phases by December 2029. The company expects to achieve FY27 revenue growth of 20 to 25% over FY26.

attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 3,983.9 Crs for H1FY27, reflecting a 39.7% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 3.6 Crs for H1FY27, compared to a loss of Rs. 8.2 Crs in the prior period. Promoter Mr. John K. Paul stepped away from the company effective 1 October 2026, with his shareholding to be transferred to continuing promoters by December 2029. The company maintains its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 20–25% over FY26.

attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Regulation 24(1) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e. 11th November, 2026, has approved the proposed appointment of the Independent Directors of the Company on the Boards of its subsidiary companies. The appointments will take effect on their appointment by the respective subsidiary companies.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited announced on 11th November 2026 that its Board of Directors approved the proposed appointment of Independent Directors to the boards of its subsidiary companies. The appointments are subject to approval by the respective subsidiaries. Ms. Preeti Reddy, with DIN 07248280, is proposed for Popular Mega Motors India Private Limited. Mr. Jacob Kurian, with DIN 00213259, is proposed for Popular Autoworks Private Limited and Imperion Cars Private Limited. Mr. Murali Narayanan Chinnasamy, with DIN 11356917, is proposed for Popular Auto Dealers Private Limited and Zparex Digisolutions Private Limited. The appointment for the material subsidiary, Popular Mega Motors India Private Limited, is mandatory under SEBI Listing Regulations. Appointments for other subsidiaries are voluntary. The effective date of appointment is upon approval by the respective subsidiary boards.

attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 11th November, 2026, has reconstituted the Stakeholders Relationship Committee and the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has reconstituted its Stakeholders Relationship Committee and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee effective 11th November 2026. The Stakeholders Relationship Committee now includes George Joseph as Chairman, with Preeti Reddy, Naveen Philip, and Murali Narayanan as members. John K Paul ceased membership on 8th October 2026 due to his board resignation. The Corporate Social Responsibility Committee comprises Naveen Philip as Chairman, Jacob Kurian, and Paul Francis Kuttukaran as members. Paul Francis Kuttukaran was inducted as a member, while John K Paul ceased membership on 8th October 2026 following his board resignation. These changes were approved by the Board of Directors during its meeting held on 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 11th November, 2026, has approved the following changes in the senior management personnel of the Company: 1. Cessation of Mr. Gopikrishnan J., as Chief Risk Officer ("CRO") of the Company with effect from 11th November, 2026, as he has relinquished the additional charge of CRO in view of his responsibilities as Head-Operations, Tamil Nadu. Mr. Gopikrishnan J., shall continue as Head-Operations, Tamil Nadu and as senior management personnel; and 2. Appointment of Mr. Adarsh Rajan as the new CRO of the Company with effect from 11th November, 2026.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has appointed Mr. Adarsh Rajan as Chief Risk Officer, effective November 11, 2026. This appointment follows the recommendation of the Risk Management Committee and approval by the Board of Directors. Mr. Rajan currently serves as a Business Analyst in the Managing Director’s Office. He holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Udaipur, and a B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from TKM College of Engineering, Kollam. He brings nearly six years of experience in business analytics, strategic consulting, and programme management. Concurrently, Mr. Gopikrishnan J. has ceased to hold the additional charge of Chief Risk Officer with effect from November 11, 2026. Mr. Gopikrishnan J. will continue as Head of Operations for Tamil Nadu and as Senior Management Personnel.

attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026, inter alia, the following business(es):1. The unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026;2. Re-composition of Stakeholders Relationship Committee and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee;3.  Appointment of Mr. Adarsh Rajan as the Chief Risk Officer of the Company, designated as Senior Management Personnel; and4. Approval of the proposed appointment of the Independent Directors of the Company on the Boards of the subsidiaries.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited reported a standalone loss of 51.99 million rupees for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, compared to a loss of 70.00 million rupees in the same period last year. The company recorded revenue from operations of 10,424.55 million rupees for the quarter. For the six-month period ended 30 September 2026, the standalone loss was 117.83 million rupees. The Board approved the unaudited financial results. The Board also re-composed the Stakeholders Relationship Committee and the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee effective 11th November 2026. Mr. Adarsh Rajan was appointed as Chief Risk Officer, replacing Mr. Gopikrishnan J. The Board approved the proposed appointment of Independent Directors to the boards of five subsidiaries.

attchmntText: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 11th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 10,424.55 million Indian Rupees. The company reported a loss before tax of 69.74 million Indian Rupees. The loss for the period was 51.99 million Indian Rupees. Earnings per share were negative 0.73 Indian Rupees. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 19,695.34 million Indian Rupees. The loss before tax was 156.55 million Indian Rupees. The loss for the period was 117.83 million Indian Rupees. Earnings per share were negative 1.65 Indian Rupees. The Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors MS KA and Associates LLP expressed no material misstatements.
